name: Modern Timed Destination Cards
useWhen: A project needs a full-bleed hero where timed destination cards promote one card into the main stage with a visible progress rail.
source: User-provided WhatsApp screenshot of a modern timed cards clip with partial visible GSAP Flip code.
implementationNotes: Use a visible progress indicator when timing changes the featured card.
Allow manual card selection and pause/play controls.
Keep timed motion away from forms and critical decision flows.
Use licensed or owned destination imagery in production; this preview uses CSS scenic fields.
Respect reduced motion by disabling timed cycling.
reducedMotion: Disable timed cycling, keep the selected card static, and let users switch cards manually.
avoid: text over busy imagery without a scrim
copying travel footage or proprietary imagery
